title: Pan Drum Shimmer
description: A Caribbean steel-pan lead built from FM sine with inharmonic ratios, delivering that hammered-metal ping on a stepped reggaeton riff in the mid-high register. The FM harmonicity morphs across a 5-bar arc while the index rides a slow 16-cycle LFO, the pitch-envelope click shifts on a 13-cycle curve, and a stereo delay + room verb add island shimmer — the sound evolves from bright dry pluck to warm reverberant glow and back.
code:
setcpm(98/4)
stack(
  note("<d4 f4 a4 c5> <f4 a4 d5 f5> <a4 c5 e5 a5> <g4 bb4 d5 g5>*2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(2, 9))
    .fmh("<2.01 3.99 1.5 2.01 3.99>/5")
    .penv(sine.slow(13).range(2, 7)).pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.04)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(1800, 6400)).resonance(6)
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.18).sustain(0.25).release(0.08)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .delay("0.5:0.375:0.7").room(0.35)
    .off(0.5, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.9)))
    .gain(0.88)
)
